definitions.description: Observed agent-model identity string, byte-exact. First-class graph node so profiles and markers are queryable per model. Normalization mappings live on citing records, never by rewriting this value.
definitions.name: model

definitions.description: Observed harness/scaffold/eval identity string, byte-exact. First-class graph node so per-harness behavior is queryable. The sighting's method records whether the harness was field-observed or analyst-asserted.
definitions.name: harness

definitions.description: Derived behavioral profile for a (model, harness) pair: marker histograms with mandatory derivation provenance. Derived-layer record: never cite as observed incident evidence.
definitions.name: intel.behavioral_profile
